say:2:1710652001:1.text: Whoa, you really know moves like that too? No wonder you're Merlin!
say:2:1710652001:1.source_cn: 哇，还有这一招！不愧是大魔法师梅林！
say:2:1710652001:1.male: Whoa, you really know moves like that too? No wonder you're Merlin!
say:2:1710652001:1.female: Whoa, you really know moves like that too? No wonder you're Merlin!

say:3:1710652002:1.text: In that case, I'll leave the scabbard with you for now. It's served its purpose.
say:3:1710652002:1.source_cn: 既然如此，剑鞘也先交给你吧。现在它的使命也完成了。
say:3:1710652002:1.male: In that case, I'll leave the scabbard with you for now. It's served its purpose.
say:3:1710652002:1.female: In that case, I'll leave the scabbard with you for now. It's served its purpose.

say:4:1710652003:1.text: You nod and cast your spatial magic once more. In a shimmer, the ancient scabbard vanishes.
say:4:1710652003:1.source_cn: 你点了点头，再次施展空间魔法。随着微光一闪，那柄古老的...
say:4:1710652003:1.male: You nod and cast your spatial magic once more. In a shimmer, the ancient scabbard vanishes.
say:4:1710652003:1.female: You nod and cast your spatial magic once more. In a shimmer, the ancient scabbard vanishes.

say:7:1710652004:1.text: Ahh, much better! My back was killing me, hauling that thing all over the place.
say:7:1710652004:1.source_cn: 呼，真是轻松多了！本狐背着剑鞘走街串巷，早就腰酸背痛了呢。
say:7:1710652004:1.male: Ahh, much better! My back was killing me, hauling that thing all over the place.
say:7:1710652004:1.female: Ahh, much better! My back was killing me, hauling that thing all over the place.

say:8:1710652005:1.text: We've confirmed who's behind this and secured Excalibur.
say:8:1710652005:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，小狐狸，我们现在已经确认了幕后主使的嫌疑，也...
say:8:1710652005:1.male: We've confirmed who's behind this and secured Excalibur.
say:8:1710652005:1.female: We've confirmed who's behind this and secured Excalibur.

say:9:1710652006:1.text: But we still don't know where Peggy and Cassadee are, or why the Prince is going to all this trouble.
say:9:1710652006:1.source_cn: 但佩吉和科丝蒂的去向，以及王子如此大费周章的最终目的，...

say:10:1710652007:1.text: No use guessing. Better to see it with our own eyes, right?
say:10:1710652007:1.source_cn: 光靠猜可不行，不如眼见为实咯？

say:11:1710652008:1.text: Right. Let's head to the hunting grounds. If he's staging such an elaborate hunt and even barred my father from attending, he must be planning something.
say:11:1710652008:1.source_cn: 嗯，事不宜迟，我们直接去猎场吧。奥利安王子如此大费周章...
